central_comic_situation: A five-hour luxury layover becomes Neet's chance to investigate everything and steal olives; Buddy cannot protect a single nap.
intended_feeling: Affectionate travel fatigue and ridiculous confidence, with quiet physical payoff.

wants.Neet: Dominate the layover, explore buttons and take buffet olives home.
wants.Buddy: Eat, nap uninterrupted and let Heather finish her shower.
wants.Heather: Find lounge, freshen up and reach gate without another international incident.

ending: Preserved final Talent, preserving comic arrogance and transit into S025 olive consequences.
